definitions.land: ≥50% of tract area in a federally recognized reservation or off-reservation trust land, or (Hawaii) ≥10% in Hawaiian Home Lands
definitions.pop: Native residents ≥20% of population (AIAN alone; in Hawaii, AIAN + NHPI alone)

sources.boundaries: Census TIGER/Line 2024 AIANNH; 2024 cartographic boundary tracts (500k)

logit.note: Logit with state fixed effects and county-clustered SEs; same controls as the main model on /designations (poverty, income, population, density, unemployment, education, renters, vacancy, home value, residents of color, OZ 1.0, NMTC, rural, CRA, Urban tiers).

reservations.note: Federally recognized reservations and off-reservation trust land with at least one eligible tract ≥50% inside it. A tract is attributed to the entity holding the most land in it.
